title: Moonwing Dust
html:
Monster drop: Luna Moth

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) and each re-enchant to one of these uses one:

  • of the Mage (gems: Iolite + Amber + any gem)
  • of the Owl (gems: Diamond + Sapphire + Sapphire)
  • Amber rings and pendants (their gem: Gem Amber)

Dropped by Moth: Moonfane Moth, Luna Moth, Lantern-Eater, Great Luna Moth, Rimewing, Mother of Moths, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Reforging & reagents for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
